steps.npc: Ahoy, young whippersnapper. Have you come to hear a tale from old Ribs?

options.text: Could you tell me about Barnacle Barnaby?

steps.player: Could you tell me about Barnacle Barnaby?

steps.npc: He was a cruel and vicious pirate. Orchestrator of the Driftwood Massacre and unleasher of the Plague of Black Mists. He believed himself untouchable, but his arrogance was his undoing.
Despite the warnings of many, Barnacle Barnaby attempted to plunder the Skullhorde, but his only reward was a deadly curse. It destroyed the Crimson Kraken, condemning all on board to a watery grave.

steps.player: And you had a map leading to the wreck of the Kraken?

steps.npc: Aye! I purchased the map from Ulrich the Unfortunate, the sole survivor of the Kraken, but I had no intention of using it. I knew that no good would ever come from seeking the Kraken.

steps.player: Then why not destroy the map?

steps.npc: And risk the wrath of Barnaby's ghost? No. I thought it better the map be locked away, so that neither it nor the curse could harm anyone else, but those young fools put an end to that.
Now we can only hope that someone puts a stop to them before it's too late. Who knows, perhaps it will be you who does so.

steps.player: Well, on that note, I'd best be getting off. Until next time, Ribs.

steps.npc: As you wish, but you would be wise to learn from your elders. My tales might one day save you from a one-way trip to see Davey Jones!
